#619 analog: keep the traffic, drop the URL; R243 produces OutboundInternetWebTraffic already carries the observable, so converting it to WebResource would add a row the maintainer's own precedent dropped (unlike R218, where no traffic row exists).

answers.a: Revise to creates DomainRegistration: #618 accepts a parent row beside its child so redundancy with T0008.002 is not grounds to retire, and #616 says assert the record; a definite verb matches R021 on the same option list (may-create is a defensible third option but I did not take it).
answers.b: Retire: #619 is the direct precedent (keep the traffic, drop the URL), R243 produces OutboundInternetWebTraffic already carries it, and accesses WebResource would attribute the AI service's fetch to the implant.
answers.c: Yes, a carrier regression: the system prompt is configuration content and the config file is only the optional second route, so keep reads ApplicationConfiguration (ApplicationConfigurationFile, not ConfigurationFile, would be the file-route class if a second row were ever wanted).
answers.d: Both are true and in the digest, but use ServiceApplicationProcess: the maintainers mapped T1046 Network Service Discovery to it in their Sept PRs after #543 had already created NetworkServiceApplicationProcess, and the dead IRI makes the adjudicator's keep wrong either way.
answers.e: Yes: DigitalText, DigitalAudio, DigitalImage and DigitalVideo are all direct children of DigitalMedia in the digest, so the collapse is right; use produces to match #608, and it stays definite on T0052 because every phishing message carries text.
answers.f: No: #618 says a parent row beside its child is accepted, so neither retire stands on redundancy; R018 is kept (container registries are a distinct referent), and R029 is kept as modifies File with its original verbatim quote.
